reviews.text:
Your application is excellent, but there is one issue we would like to see improved.

We would like to monitor DNS traffic and queries without requiring a VPN connection. Currently, the application only displays DNS queries when traffic is routed through the VPN.

It would be much better if the app could display all DNS queries directly, similar to how NextDNS works, allowing users to monitor every DNS request regardless of whether a VPN is being used.

Thank you for your efforts and for developing this great application.

reviews.title: Cant go online anymore without Adguard
reviews.text:
IMO, What used to be a far out nerd accessory helper, in an addon browser store, is now a baseline for any daily internet use. Its not just ads anymore. It's a huge amount of daily rotating threats that manifest as fast as a filter is written. And tethered to the top level ads as an attack surface.

Years ago, one could surf online in relative ease without much thought other than installing a free firewall with carefully updated definitions from open source projects. That just cant cut it any longer.

It's not ads that are the issue today so much as it is what is tailing the backend of these ads. Websites that complain about adblockers fail to properly assess that the issue isnt their ad revenue loss, its that their ads are entirely open to infecting the user just by existing. 

When the anti adblocks pop up and block the read on their site, due to use of an adblocker by the reader, one has to wonder if the website is thus asking that the reader give over full exposure just to read their site material and be compliant with an open attack surface through their ad vehicle. With that being the case for so many today I imagine that these sites will eventually just cease to exist. Personally I am not risking my identity my financials or my hardware just for a ten second read somewhere.

Adguard has matured from a fledgling open source browser add on to a full scale cross platform multiuse firewall. It is functional stable and steady with definition updates.

Thank you.

reviews.title: Great app by a great company
reviews.text:
Long time user here, I truly appreciate the small things and AdGuard is great for what
is offered here in a tiny yet Powerful application. 

I've found very few issues with utilizing Adguard Solutions for my daily needs.

I love the privacy transparancy with this app stating no data will be collected. 

This privacy stance should be industry standard for all apps on app store, thankfully there are still some good companies like AdGuard still around who do not collect user data. (Except if you click on the button that send's your anonymous usage data- I don't like that button, however at-least it's not on by default.) 

For now, we have AdGuard - the gold standard, for they do not collect user information and their product works. 

That is the reason I give this app a true perfect 5 score - it does what it says and the yearly price is value oriented and it just works. 

It works as a standalone dashboard (useful as I can assess the trackers being sent across applicitions) 

It also works as an adblocker for safari and it even provides more: 

For example, AdGuard has a Local DNS filtration mechanism. They create a local vpn for this and it does actually work. Seamlessly. 

There are so many other features under the hood of this app. 

Bonus: You can literally block all of Facebook or anything you like - using AdGuard. 

Give Adguard a try- it can't hurt they offer a 7 day Free trial too. 

Keep up the great work Adguard team!
